status: native garment sprite plus full-body pre-rendered experimental looks in Dress Me
caveats: Only Combination #165 is enabled for native photographic preview.
Whole-body photographic looks are fixed, pre-rendered images; they cannot be dynamically recolored or separately dressed yet.
Other garment/skin/hair/customization choices automatically return to the editable illustrated renderer.
Native garment sprite images are available for inspecting fabric details; they are not registered to the exact model pose.
Photographic pixels include real shading; their sampled RGB does not equal the source Wada color at every pixel.
